top_level.attack: Contrasted against current theory and live card.
top_level.defense: Accurately names the three core domains.

top_level.current_content: Ficha de caso que distingue evidencia observada, contribución del modelo, incertidumbre y decisión humana
top_level.attack: Promises a distinction the current playground violates by putting derived features in evidence; lacks lineage.
top_level.defense: The four-layer framing itself is strong.
top_level.improved_content: Ficha de caso trazable que enlaza evidencia observada con provenance, contribución fiel del modelo, incertidumbre medida y decisión humana registrada sin confundir ninguna capa.
top_level.justification: Keeps the conceptual spine but makes traceability/explanation fidelity explicit.

top_level.current_content: En un workbench de riesgo operativo (cola de fraude en Lima, datos sintéticos) el analista no solo mira un score: arma una ficha de caso que separa evidencia observada, contribución del modelo, incertidumbre y decisión humana. Aquí aprendes a explicar un score sin acusar de fraude ni de parentesco, y a dejar un audit trail (rastro de quién decidió qué). Sin ese rastro, el override (decisión humana que reemplaza al modelo) no es gobernanza, es opacidad.
top_level.attack: Reframes the target as a fraud queue and assumes a score fit for explanation without lineage.
top_level.defense: Human review, four-layer separation and audit trail are job-relevant.
top_level.improved_content: En un workbench de riesgo operativo con datos sintéticos, el analista trabaja sobre una **cola de revisión**, no una cola que ya haya concluido fraude. Cada caso debe enlazar una predicción fuera de muestra con su evidencia observada, la contribución fiel del modelo, una incertidumbre documentada y la decisión humana. El audit trail conserva quién hizo qué, cuándo, por qué y sobre qué versión del sistema; sin esa reconstrucción, un override no es gobernanza.
top_level.justification: Keeps fraud out of the target and makes the workplace artifact auditable.

callouts.title: Gate CP-N3-C
callouts.current_content: Inicio CP-N3-C: la ficha distingue las cuatro capas; explicar no es acusar. No des por cerrada la sección si falta evidencia, banda de incertidumbre o audit trail del override.
callouts.attack: The stated gate is stricter or differently scoped than executable code.
callouts.improved_content: Reword after implementing validators so evidence provenance, valid uncertainty and reconstructible audit trail are required rather than merely present.

callouts.title: Contrato local
callouts.current_content: Evidencia mínima S35-T1-A: ranking de drops con means_fraud=False. Breach → REJECT_CAUSAL_CLAIM; falta drops → REQUEST_METRIC_DROP.
callouts.attack: The stated gate is stricter or differently scoped than executable code.
callouts.improved_content: Require a computed permutation report bound to a fitted/evaluated model; then validate forbidden claim semantics rather than a literal flag.

callouts.title: Contrato local
callouts.current_content: Contrato S35-T1-B: 4 capas + causal=False. Breach → REJECT_CAUSAL_CLAIM; falta capas → REQUEST_LAYER_FIELDS.
callouts.attack: Canonical code does not build 4 layers and causal is hard-coded.
callouts.improved_content: Require four validated/linkable layers and explanation fidelity before applying claim-policy validation.

callouts.title: Contrato local
callouts.current_content: Antes de promover S35-T2-A, audita n por slice. low_n no prueba inequidad; afirmación con n bajo → REJECT_LOW_N_CLAIM; falta n → REQUEST_SLICE_N. min_n=30 es política del lab.
callouts.attack: Total n alone is insufficient and code accepts invalid n.
callouts.defense: It correctly says low_n proves neither inequity nor parity and labels 30 as lab policy.
callouts.improved_content: Require metrics from frozen rows with metric-specific denominators, valid support and uncertainty; keep min_n=30 explicitly didactic.

callouts.title: Contrato local
callouts.current_content: S35-T2-B: lista high + action. Breach → REJECT_PROXY_FEATURE; falta audit → REQUEST_PROXY_AUDIT.
callouts.attack: Support is ignored and metrics share arbitrary threshold; mitigation is not evaluated.
callouts.defense: No auto-label is a correct boundary.
callouts.improved_content: Require defined proxy statistics with support/uncertainty and treat mitigation as a re-evaluated candidate change.

callouts.title: Contrato local
callouts.current_content: S35-T3-A: intervalo + level. Breach → REJECT_POINT_ONLY; falta q → REQUEST_INTERVAL. Conformal: conceptual (cobertura); código del lab es banda toy.
callouts.attack: Any arbitrary q can satisfy the structural band requirement.
callouts.defense: It honestly says the band is toy and not conformal.
callouts.improved_content: Separate a presentation-only toy band from the empirical uncertainty gate; validate p/q and method provenance.

callouts.title: Contrato local
callouts.current_content: S35-T3-B: abstain en OOD. Breach → REJECT_AUTO_LABEL; falta política → REQUEST_OOD_POLICY.
callouts.attack: The detector cannot establish the stated OOD cases and abstain is disconnected from frozen policy.
callouts.improved_content: Name the actual knowledge-limit check, require reference provenance and route through the versioned abstention policy.

callouts.title: Contrato local
callouts.current_content: S35-T4-A: keys + out_of_scope. Breach → REJECT_SCOPE_BREACH; falta keys → REQUEST_CARD_KEYS.
callouts.attack: Validator checks only key presence and can pass forbidden use/false contestability.
callouts.improved_content: Validate model-card values, lineage and a real contestability channel/state, not only keys.

callouts.title: Contrato local
callouts.current_content: S35-T4-B: audit mínimo con case, human y by no vacío. Breach → REJECT_SILENT_OVERRIDE; falta fields → REQUEST_AUDIT_FIELDS. Portfolio: añade ts, reason y model_version para reconstrucción real.
callouts.attack: Even the portfolio fields are incomplete and audit_event validates only truthiness.
callouts.defense: The prose acknowledges the minimal lab event is insufficient.
callouts.improved_content: Require a typed append-only AuditEvent with event_id, actor/action/time/reason/model-policy refs and state transition fields when relevant.

figures.caption: Estar fuera de distribución no añade una quinta capa: se registra dentro de la incertidumbre, como su razón.
figures.alt: Grafo de cuatro nodos en fila: evidencia, contribución del modelo, incertidumbre y decisión humana.

supplemental_theory.title: Practica la ficha de caso CP-N3-C
supplemental_theory.current_behavior: Current SectionView mapping for `system-design` builds evidence=['shared_phone','amount_z_high'], model score/flags, toy band + max-z OOD, minimal human event and four-key card; `portfolio_ready` checks only not means_fraud, not causal, use!=fraud_label, contestability and non-empty by.
supplemental_theory.attack: The playground is now on-topic, rejecting the historical ADR finding, but it misclassifies derived features as observed evidence and its final gate ignores evidence validity, uncertainty validity/coverage, OOD provenance, slices, model-card completeness and audit lineage.
supplemental_theory.defense: It now follows CP-N3-C rather than the old system-design ADR topic and demonstrates the intended four layers.
supplemental_theory.improved_content: Use evidence records/IDs in layer 1; model features only in layer 2; run layer validators and require every gate (evidence provenance, explanation fidelity, uncertainty status, policy/OOD provenance, card scope/lineage, reconstructible human event) before `portfolio_ready=True`.
supplemental_theory.justification: Learner-facing Theory supplement must obey the same contracts as canonical theory.
